tradingConditionsUpdate.banner: Peach has updated the trading conditions, press to read more!
tradingConditionsUpdate.title: trading conditions updated
tradingConditionsUpdate.buyer.text:
Peach has some temporary changes to its trading system.

First of all: only very highly trusted sellers with a long reputation at Peach can sell. Peach created a very demanding set of criteria to allow sellers to participate.

Temporarily, Peach's escrow system doesn't have any control from Peach's part: the seller fully controls the escrowed BTC.

In case of dispute, Peach is still available to assist and mediate the dispute, and in ultimate cases provide full support if the seller is acting wrongfully.

Any questions, please contact us directly!
tradingConditionsUpdate.text.bold: Peach's escrow system doesn't have any control from Peach's part
tradingConditionsUpdate.seller.text:
Peach has some temporary changes to its trading system.

First of all: only very highly trusted sellers with a long reputation at Peach can sell. Peach created a very demanding set of criteria to allow sellers to participate.

Temporarily, Peach's escrow system doesn't have any control from Peach's part: as the seller, you fully control the escrowed BTC. Peach can't release or refund it for you, so keep your wallet backup safe: if you lose access to your wallet, the BTC can't be recovered.

Unless you are KYC-verified, you can only have one ongoing trade at a time.

In case of dispute, Peach is still available to assist and mediate.

Any questions, please contact us directly!
